name: Survey tile in Sextans
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 2.2 degrees south of the ecliptic in Sextans, imaged by SPHEREx 16 times in 5 visits over 32 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 34 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 32 hours starting 2025-11-28, at wavelengths from 1.11 to 4.42 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
